proposed_comments.title: Preserve subsequent settings saves during watcher callbacks

confidence.rationale: The pinned caller keeps the read guard alive through the callback, while the writer uses POSIX replacement. An isolated overlap test reproduced ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION 32 without the flag and passed with the exact one-line replacement.

proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve subsequent settings saves during watcher callbacks

**Severity:** `medium`

`openForReadCallback` holds this read handle open while it invokes `m_callback`. If another settings save arrives during that callback, `atomic_file::write` needs delete sharing for its POSIX replacement; without it, the retry loop ends with `ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION` and the save fails. Add `FILE_SHARE_DELETE` to this handle's sharing mask so the next save can replace the file while the callback finishes.

```suggestion
            wil::unique_hfile file(CreateFileW(path.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, nullptr));
```

proposed_comments.title: Declare WIL for the CommonLib test project

confidence.rationale: The changed project directly includes the WIL package path, its new source reaches WIL through FileWatcher.h, and a clean targeted restore/build failed on the missing target before succeeding after the package was declared.

proposed_comments.body:
### Declare WIL for the CommonLib test project

**Severity:** `low`

The changed test project adds a WIL include path and its new tests include `FileWatcher.h`, but `src/common/UnitTests-CommonLib/packages.config` still declares only CppWinRT; the referenced SettingsAPI project also requires the WIL targets. Restoring and building this test project with only its declared packages fails on the missing `Microsoft.Windows.ImplementationLibrary.targets`; adding WIL 1.0.260126.7 to this test project's package list restores the dependency and the focused native build succeeds. Please add that package entry to `src/common/UnitTests-CommonLib/packages.config` so the project does not rely on unrelated consumers having restored WIL.
